source: FastestKnownTime route pages (fastestknowntime.com/route/<slug>-wa), GPX file linked under GPS Track. 25 Washington pages found by probing <peak>-wa for 406 Washington peak areas; 24 link a GPX.
rule: A track is written only when (a) the FKT route description names the database route, (b) the route's current track fails assessTrack() (scripts/audit-track-completeness.mjs), and (c) the FKT track passes assessTrack() against that route's own trailhead and summit pins. Pins alone cannot tell routes apart (Dragontail's routes share one trailhead and summit), so pins are never the only test.
